purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are prioritization signals, not measured search volumes and not proof of eligibility, amount, deadline safety, open application or payment. Forum and search-language patterns are discovery-only; association grant facts require current primary-source verification.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volumes.

demand_signal.basis: Official sources expose many purpose-specific national, EU, local and foundation routes, while ordinary association language starts from the need rather than the programme name. This is a qualitative discovery signal, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The same word 'bidrag' can mean municipal association support, national purpose-specific grants, Arvsfonden project/local support or a private foundation. Organisation type, activity purpose, geography and support form can change the path.

miss_consequence.basis: Poor routing can waste volunteer capacity, surface irrelevant sports-only support, miss local opportunities or cause an organisation to plan around a grant whose applicant or purpose rules do not fit.

source_fragmentation.basis: Relevant discovery spans municipalities, MUCF, Allmänna arvsfonden, foundations and sometimes sector-specific bodies. No one source safely represents all association funding.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as organisationsbidrag, projektbidrag, lokalstöd, utlysning and stiftelseregister are easy to collapse into a generic 'grant' concept, and the previous pilot returned Swedish-only result explanations even after Arabic or Persian selection.

steps_to_action.basis: A useful path should preserve known actor context, identify the need, then choose local municipality versus current national/EU calls versus Arvsfonden/foundation discovery, followed by current applicant/purpose/deadline verification.

recurrence_signal.basis: The confusion repeats across project, premises, ongoing activity and equipment questions because associations often search by need rather than funding programme name.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The public person pilot asked association versus company even when actor_type=association was already known, then returned the same static sports-heavy result bundle for association and small-company choices regardless of selected need.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Keep one shared person product. Reuse actor_type=association instead of asking association/company again, rank source families by the selected need, stop showing RF/LOK as generic association support, keep company users on the existing company pilot, localize the guidance, and make Stiftelsesök explicitly discovery-only. Convert the miss into permanent scenarios and executable CI guardrails.
signals.truth_rule: Discovery language and directory hits are signals, not truth. Verify applicant type, purpose, current application state, deadline, amount and required documents in the responsible primary source before they affect truth-bearing product behavior. Never infer open application or eligibility from association status, a registry hit or prior AI output.
